title: NIST WebBook: Sulfur is S, molecular weight 32.065 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sulfur as S, molecular weight 32.065 amu, CAS 7704-34-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sulfur, CAS Registry Number 7704-34-9, lists molecular formula S and molecular weight 32.065 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 31.97207100 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/S. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
